  dbname: dbname

  password: password
---

```{r, echo = FALSE, include = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

options(scipen = 999)

class_data <- file_check |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  dplyr::rename_with(~ ifelse(. == "report_year" | . == "year", "report_year", .)) |> 
  dplyr::rename_with(~ ifelse(. == "classification_of_energy_delivered_to_ultimate_consumers", "customer_type", .)) |> 
  dplyr::rename_with(~ ifelse(. == "megawatt_hours", "mwh_delivered", .)) |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~ ifelse(. == "number_of_customers_at_end_of_year", "customer_count", .)) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(utility_id = as.numeric(utility_id))

#connect to data warehouse
db <- RPostgreSQL::dbConnect(RPostgreSQL::PostgreSQL(),
                 dbname = dbname, 
                 host = host, 
                 port = port, 
                 user = user, 
                 password = password)

```

```{sql connection=db, echo = FALSE, output.var = "utility_table"}

SELECT DISTINCT utility_name, mn_utility_id AS utility_id
FROM energy.utility_info 

```

Check for duplicate entries
```{r, echo = FALSE}
dup_check <- class_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(utility_id = as.character(utility_id), 
                report_year = as.character(report_year)) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(row_id = paste(utility_id, customer_type, report_year, sep = "_")) |> 
                  dplyr::group_by(row_id) |>
  dplyr::mutate(count = dplyr::n()) |>
  dplyr::filter(count > 1)

if(nrow(dup_check) == 0){

  print("No duplicates found")

} else{

  print("The following rows are duplicates")

  DT::datatable(dup_check)

}
```

Check for invalid customer classes

```{sql connection = db, echo = FALSE, output.var = "valid_classes"}
SELECT DISTINCT customer_type 
FROM energy.all_class
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
class_data |> 
  dplyr::rename(class = customer_type) |> 
  dplyr::filter(!c(class %in% valid_classes$customer_type) & class != "Entered Total")
```

Check MWH outliers that warrant a follow up. These entries deviate more than 100% (either direction) from the previous 3 years of entries from these utilities.

```{sql connection=db, echo = FALSE, output.var = "avg_sales"}

WITH max_year AS (

	SELECT MAX(report_year) AS max_year
	
	FROM energy.all_class

), 

year_subset AS (

	SELECT * 

	FROM energy.all_class 

	WHERE report_year > (SELECT MAX(max_year) FROM max_year) - 3

)

SELECT 
	utility, 
	utility_id, 
	customer_type, 
	ROUND(AVG(customer_count))AS avg_customer_count, 
	ROUND(AVG(mwh_delivered)) AS avg_mwh_delivered, 
	ROUND(AVG(revenue)) AS avg_revenue
	
FROM year_subset

GROUP BY 
	utility, 
	utility_id, 
	customer_type

HAVING ROUND(AVG(mwh_delivered)) IS NOT NULL	
	
ORDER BY 
	utility, 
	customer_type


```


```{r, echo = FALSE}

outliers <- file_check |> 
  dplyr::left_join(avg_sales, by = c("utility" = "utility", "utility_id" = "utility_id", "customer_type" = "customer_type")) |> 
  dplyr::filter(complete.cases(mwh_delivered), 
                mwh_delivered > 0) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(percent_dif = (mwh_delivered / avg_mwh_delivered) - 1 ) |> 
  dplyr::filter(abs(percent_dif) > 1) |> 
  dplyr::select(utility, utility_id, customer_type, mwh_delivered, avg_mwh_delivered, percent_dif, customer_count, avg_customer_count, revenue, avg_revenue)
  
DT::datatable(outliers)

```
